rationale: The supplied excerpts establish public interfaces and broad obligations but omit the implementation ranges that determine actual behavior. These eight ranges cover the highest-priority responsibility coordinates: decision formation and progression, authority transitions, recovery and resynchronization, configuration changes, decision application, history lifecycle, and client-visible completion. Cached ranges are not repeated; each request is an exact contiguous interval and remains within the 160-line limit.
gap: Current evidence is insufficient to recover the concrete fact lifecycle or classify all seven responsibility coordinates. In particular, the omitted ranges are needed to determine whether persistence precedes acknowledgement, how stale or concurrent results are filtered, how snapshots interact with committed and applied indexes, and which configuration version governs each consumer. No semantic defect or correctness conclusion is supported yet.
